## Welcome to the 1 Shamelin Cube Open 2026
[![Malaysia Cube Sports Association(MYCSA)](https://i.imgur.com/ZUv6wZJm.png)](https://www.mycubeassociation.org/competition/info/1ShamelinCubeOpen2026)
​

**If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the [Information & Announcements](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/1ShamelinCubeOpen2026#73185-information-announcements). All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.**
​
Competitors should ***ensure that their email address registered with the WCA is valid and up-to-date***, as organizers will use it to send important competition updates and pre-competition information.
​
***Our schedule, cutoff & time limit is subject to change based on the number of registrants for each event; please pay close attention throughout the open registration period to see if our schedule has been adjusted.***
